name: psa_directory
description: Search the school directory before creating leads. Does not send email. Requires read.

name: psa_profile
description: Read your name, phone and mailbox connection status. Never returns mail credentials. Requires read.

name: psa_edit_profile
description: Update only the connected employee name or phone. Account credentials remain private. Requires write.

name: psa_bulk_school_stage
description: Change the stage of up to 100 accessible schools atomically. Review names and current stages first. Requires write.

name: psa_create_school
description: Add a school with duplicate protection. Use contact import for multi-contact lists. Requires write.

name: psa_edit_school
description: Edit school details, stage, county, notes or next action using normal school access rules. Requires write.

name: psa_delete_schools
description: Permanently delete selected owned schools. Review IDs and names first. Sent history is retained. Requires write.

name: psa_add_contact
description: Add a role-based school contact. School-specific suppression is separate from global mailbox opt-outs. Requires write.

name: psa_edit_contact
description: Edit a linked contact using current link and contact versions. Only admins may lift suppression. Requires write.

name: psa_report_contact
description: Record an opt-out, complaint or review signal and pause affected outreach. Explain the source. Requires write.

name: psa_assignment_preview
description: Admin: preview moving matching schools to a rep or the unassigned pool. Never changes owners. Requires write.

name: psa_assignment_commit
description: Admin: apply a reviewed, unexpired school assignment. Changed selections require a new preview. Requires write.

name: psa_claim_school
description: Claim one unassigned school for the connected employee. Competing claims return a conflict. Requires write.

name: psa_find_schools
description: Find nearby schools using address or coordinates, keywords and radius. May call the location provider. Requires read.

name: psa_place_details
description: Read contact details for a discovered place ID. Requires read.

name: psa_save_discovered_schools
description: Save selected discovered schools with duplicate checks. Reps can assign only to themselves. Requires write.

name: psa_map_accounts
description: Read owned school coordinates, stages and rep colors for territory planning. Requires read.

name: psa_locate_schools
description: Resolve missing coordinates in a bounded pass using the existing location cache. Requires write.

name: psa_map_layers
description: Read saved PSA, partner and elementary prospect map layers. Requires read.

name: psa_refresh_map_layers
description: Admin: refresh saved prospect map layers from their configured source. Requires write.

name: psa_plan_visits
description: Suggest a bounded visit order from a starting address and selected coordinates. Not driving directions. Requires read.

name: psa_template_versions
description: Read saved text and PDF revision history for a shared template. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_create_template
description: Admin: create a shared email template with reusable catalog PDF IDs. Does not send mail. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_edit_template
description: Admin: edit or archive a shared template with its current revision; queued copy stays frozen. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_seed_templates
description: Admin: add missing Winter 2027 templates without replacing later edits. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_publish_pdf
description: Admin: copy an approved built-in PSA PDF into the reusable catalog. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_upload_pdf
description: Admin: upload a chosen PDF to the reusable catalog. Supply filename and base64 bytes; maximum 10 MB decoded. Never sends mail. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_upload_templates
description: Admin: upload template JSON for a review preview. Review then commit; existing edits are preserved. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_commit_template_import
description: Admin: commit a reviewed template JSON import by its returned review ID. Stale reviews are rejected. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_create_sequence
description: Admin: create a versioned follow-up definition; does not enroll or send to contacts. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_edit_sequence
description: Admin: edit or archive a follow-up definition using its revision. Changes stop existing enrollments so they need a new review. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_sequence_versions
description: Read follow-up definition revisions. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_sequence_originals
description: Read eligible original messages before preparing a follow-up plan. No enrollment or sending. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_mail_limits
description: Read the connected employee daily sending allowance. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_outreach_campaigns
description: Read outreach campaign IDs and their current daily caps. Does not authorize sending. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_create_outreach_campaign
description: Admin: create a distinct outreach campaign label and cap with a reason. Does not approve recipients or start sending. Requires library:manage.

name: psa_worker_status
description: Read sending worker freshness and queue status. Requires outreach:read.

name: psa_program_commissions
description: Admin: read seasonal commission records and rep/season totals. Requires read.

name: psa_create_commission
description: Admin: record one school/program/season commission with explicit rep payout. Requires commissions:manage.

name: psa_edit_commission
description: Admin: correct or void a commission using the current revision; history is preserved. Requires commissions:manage.

name: psa_commission_history
description: Admin: read correction history for a seasonal commission. Requires read.

name: psa_set_team_access
description: Admin: change a teammate admin role; normal self/last-admin protections remain. Requires team:manage.

name: psa_join_links
description: Admin: list employee join-link metadata. Requires read.

name: psa_create_join_link
description: Admin: create an employee join link with explicit expiry and use limit. Treat the returned invite token as private. Requires team:manage.

name: psa_revoke_join_link
description: Admin: revoke one employee join link. Requires team:manage.

name: psa_businesses
description: Search Business Sales prospects and sponsors. Employee ownership rules apply. Requires read.

name: psa_business
description: Read one Business Sales prospect, notes and conversation timeline. Requires read.

name: psa_create_business
description: Add a Business Sales prospect with duplicate checks. Never sends email. Requires write.

name: psa_edit_business
description: Edit business details, sponsorship value, stage, notes, next action or owner (admin only). Requires write.

name: psa_capabilities
description: Check operation availability, delegated permissions and human-only controls for this connection.

name: psa_prepare_reply
description: Prepare a threaded reply for private human review. Requires outreach:prepare. Never approves or sends; execute the approved draft with psa_execute_approved_outreach.
